title: Tru Tien Episode 14: The Red Gate Alliance
audience: Fans of Korean fantasy, Solo Leveling viewers, action fans, 18-35 demographic
tone: Political tension, conspiracy, alliance forming, power negotiation

concept.hook: The Japanese Hunter Association sent their top negotiator: 'We want Jin-Woo. We'll pay three times his weight in gold — and give Korea access to our S-rank weapons.' Jin-Woo: 'I don't work for governments.'
concept.story_arc: Japanese delegation arrives → Offers huge payment + weapons for Jin-Woo → Korean government officials visibly tempted → Jin-Woo's response → Japanese negotiator shocked → Jin-Woo walks away
concept.emotion: Negotiation → Temptation → Official's greed → Jin-Woo's cold refusal → Shock → Walk away

shots.prompt: Wide shot — formal government conference room. Japanese delegation in expensive suits sits on one side. Korean government officials on the other. A holographic display shows Jin-Woo's photo. Camera: wide — formal conference room, Japanese delegation, Korean officials, holographic display of Jin-Woo, diplomatic atmosphere. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — formal conference room, Japanese and Korean delegations, Jin-Woo holographic display, diplomatic meeting, 6s
shots.narration: The Japanese Hunter Association sent their top negotiator. Gold. S-rank weapons. And a proposal that would make Korea's military untouchable.
shots.sfx: Formal meeting atmosphere, diplomatic murmurs, holographic display humming, papers shuffling, tense silence

shots.prompt: Close-up — Japanese negotiator slides a contract across the table. 'Three billion won. Per mission. Plus transfer of three S-rank weapon technologies.' The Korean officials' eyes widen. One licks his lips. Camera: close-up — contract sliding across table, three billion won amount visible, Korean officials' greedy expressions, negotiator's confident smile. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — contract sliding across table, three billion won visible, Korean officials' greedy widening eyes, negotiator's confident smile, 6s
shots.narration: Three billion won — per mission. Plus S-rank weapons technology. The Korean officials were calculating the military advantage in their heads.
shots.sfx: Contract sliding, officials' sharp inhale, money counting sounds, greedy breathing, negotiator's confident voice

shots.prompt: Close-up — Jin-Woo sits at the end of the table. He doesn't look at the contract. He looks at the Japanese negotiator. 'No.' The negotiator blinks. 'Three billion — per MISSION?' Jin-Woo: 'I don't work for governments.' Camera: close-up — Jin-Woo's cold calm face, negotiator's confused blink, 'I don't work for governments' line, frozen officials. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — Jin-Woo's cold calm face, negotiator's confused blink, 'I don't work for governments,' frozen officials, 6s
shots.narration: 'I don't work for governments.' The negotiator's confident smile — froze. The Korean officials — who had been calculating military budgets — went silent.
shots.sfx: Contract sliding stop, negotiator's confused blink, Jin-Woo's cold voice, silence falling, officials' disappointed exhale

shots.prompt: Close-up — Japanese negotiator's face hardens. 'You're making a mistake, Jin-Woo. Japan's hunting network is global. We can make your life — very difficult.' Jin-Woo stands. His shadow ripples under his feet. Camera: close-up — negotiator's hardening face, threatening tone, Jin-Woo standing, shadow rippling ominously under his feet, cold smile. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — negotiator's face hardening with threat, Jin-Woo standing, shadow rippling ominously under his feet, cold smile, 6s
shots.narration: The negotiator's threat hung in the air. Jin-Woo stood. And his shadow moved — independently. The negotiator stopped mid-sentence.
shots.sfx: Threatening voice, Jin-Woo standing, shadow rippling ominously, negotiator stopping mid-sentence, ominous sound, tension spike

shots.prompt: Wide shot — Jin-Woo walks past the table. He doesn't look back. 'I cleared an S-rank gate — alone. What exactly are you going to make difficult?' The door closes behind him. The Japanese negotiator sits in silence. Camera: wide — Jin-Woo walking past the table, shadow following him, door closing, Japanese negotiator sitting frozen in silence, Korean officials stunned. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — Jin-Woo walking past the table with shadow following, door closing behind him, Japanese negotiator frozen in silence, Korean officials stunned, 6s
shots.narration: He walked out. No one followed. The Japanese negotiator sat in silence — because he had just made the most powerful hunter on earth an enemy. For free.
shots.sfx: Footsteps walking, door closing, silence after closure, negotiator's disappointed breathing, wind after departure

audio.narration: The Japanese Hunter Association sent their top negotiator. Gold. S-rank weapons. And a proposal that would make Korea's military untouchable. Three billion won — per mission. Plus S-rank weapons technology. The Korean officials were calculating the military advantage in their heads. 'I don't work for governments.' The negotiator's confident smile — froze. The Korean officials — who had been calculating military budgets — went silent. The negotiator's threat hung in the air. Jin-Woo stood. And his shadow moved — independently. The negotiator stopped mid-sentence. He walked out. No one followed. The Japanese negotiator sat in silence — because he had just made the most powerful hunter on earth an enemy. For free.
audio.bg_music: Dark diplomatic tension, negotiation power play, shadow monarch threat, cold walk away 85 BPM

metadata.youtube_description: Episode 14 of Solo Leveling (Trừ Tiên). Japan sends their top negotiator with a lucrative offer: three billion won per mission plus S-rank weapons technology. The Korean officials are tempted. Jin-Woo: 'I don't work for governments.' When threatened, his shadow moves on its own. He walks out — the negotiator now has the world's most powerful hunter as an enemy.
